title: When LLMs Disagree: Diagnosing Relevance Filtering Bias and Retrieval Divergence in SDG Search

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing binary relevance labels assigned by two different LLMs (LLaMA and Qwen) to scholarly abstracts related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), analyzing the lexical and topical divergence of disagreement subsets using TF-IDF and KL divergence, and measuring how these filtering differences propagate into downstream ranked retrieval.
